function isIOSDevice(): boolean;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/ios.ts:24

Whether the runtime is an iOS-family device — direct iPhone/iPad/iPod UA match, or iPadOS 13+ "desktop mode" which reports a Macintosh UA while still exposing multi-touch (maxTouchPoints > 0).

Returns

boolean

true on iPhone, iPad and iPod touch; false everywhere else.
